description: This file contains shell script functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for a device possibly based on the bcm6358 hardware. It defines functions for checking image validity and performing upgrades with a default fallback.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the provided firmware image is valid. Currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific upgrade procedure, defaulting to 'default_do_upgrade' for any board name.
